purpose: Record deterministic CPU packing of multiple emitters into the renderer-wide derived particle-light budget.

algorithm.storage: selected shared lights occupy source slot zero; slot one keeps geometry and presentation only
algorithm.drop_accounting: sum per-source omissions plus candidates excluded by global truncation

scope: CPU packing tests only. The live Renderer still accepts one source and does not call the multi-source storage packer; no dual-source GPU, visual or performance result is claimed.
historical_snapshot_note: This report records the narrower single-source validation scope at the time it was captured. Current live dual-source implementation evidence is in measurements-multi-emitter-shadow-invalidation.json; use the linked report for current runtime status.
